formation_modes.What happens: Primary sources, rigorous textbooks, data, artifacts, works of art, historical documents, field observation.
formation_modes.Why: Acquire contact with the thing itself before excessive summary.

formation_modes.What happens: Derive, diagram, explain, retrieve, solve, compare, build concept maps, reproduce examples without aid.
Repeated exercises with feedback, spacing, interleaving, increasing difficulty, error taxonomy.
formation_modes.Why: Convert declarative knowledge into fluent capability.

formation_modes.What happens: Experiments, code, essays, designs, models, performances, repairs, interviews, research.
Seminar, Socratic questioning, peer review, debate, listening, design critique, negotiation.
formation_modes.Why: Expose hidden assumptions and learn in intellectual community.

formation_modes.What happens: Use knowledge for a real person, institution, community, field site, or operational system.
formation_modes.Why: Discover consequences absent from classroom exercises.

formation_modes.What happens: Construct counterexamples, edge cases, adversarial prompts, failure injections, alternative interpretations.
formation_modes.Why: Train robustness rather than polished normal cases.

formation_modes.What happens: Rank alternatives, study expert exemplars, defend criteria, revise taste.
Make probabilistic forecasts and consequential decisions before outcomes are known.
Teach a novice, translate across disciplines/languages/media, create worked examples.
formation_modes.Why: Reveal whether knowledge is organized enough to explain.

formation_modes.What happens: Oral defense, perturbation, hostile but fair questioning, identify unresolved uncertainty.
Return weeks/months later, often without AI or notes, and solve a changed problem.
formation_modes.Why: Distinguish task performance from retained learning.
